base_registry.note: The pinned registry carries school and public scopes for other countries; it has no Hungarian scope, so this supplement adds HU without altering the shared registry.

evidence.observed_facts: The full 2027 calendar year is covered by the statutory list. Substitute workdays (áthelyezett munkanapok) are set by ministerial decree under 102. § (5) by 31 October of the preceding year; no 2027 decree was found in the Magyar Közlöny as of 2026-11-24, so no substitute day is claimed. A secondary Hungarian calendar page read on 2026-11-24 states that the 2027 work-order decree had not appeared by 2026-11-12, and that no 2027 public holiday falls on a Tuesday or Thursday, so past practice would leave nothing to relocate; it counts 253 working days. That is a secondary reading, not the decree, so the substitute-day answer stays unknown.

coverage.source_title: Mt. 102. § (2012. évi I. törvény a munka törvénykönyvéről)
verification_questions: Read the 2027 work-order decree when it is published and add any substitute workday; until then no substitute day is claimed.

evidence.observed_facts: The statutory list was read on the day. The 2027 calendar date is derived from that fixed list; Easter-dependent dates use the Gregorian computus (Easter Sunday 2027-03-28). No 2027 work-order decree (áthelyezett munkanap) was published as of 2026-11-24, so substitute days are unknown.

holidays.source_locator: 102. § (1): „Munkaszüneti nap: január 1., március 15., nagypéntek, húsvéthétfő, május 1., pünkösdhétfő, augusztus 20., október 23., november 1. és december 24–26.”
